headline: 倫敦影展文學節將登場
context: 流行歌手杜娃·黎波（Dua Lipa）將策劃今年的倫敦文學節，並親自訪談柴娣·史密斯（Zadie Smith），陣容還包括佩蒂·史密斯（Patti Smith）等名人。同一時間，倫敦影展公布開幕片是安德魯·斯考特（Andrew Scott）主演的《Elsinore》，改編自演員伊恩·查里森（Ian Charleson）生前故事，該片被視為本屆奧斯卡熱門候補。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The pop star is curating the 2026 festival, which also features Patti Smith, Mustafa and Ta-Nehisi Coates, as part of the Southbank Centre’s anniversary year Zadie Smith, Patti Smith and Mustafa are among the star names lined up to be interviewed by Dua Lipa, as the pop star reveals her curation of this year’s London Literature festival at the Southbank Centre. The festival, now in its 19th year, will run from 21 October to 1 November, with the Brit award-winning singer shaping a programme of events in collaboration with her Service95 book club. Continue reading...
sources.title: Dua Lipa to interview Zadie Smith at London Literature festival

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: ‘Few films will leave a lasting imprint on audiences this year quite like Elsinore,’ LFF director says of movie about Chariots of Fire actor Elsinore, one of the most hotly anticipated dramas of the year, has been announced as the opening night film at this year’s London film festival. The drama, which stars Andrew Scott as actor Ian Charleson, will have its European premiere at the Southbank Centre – yards from the National Theatre, in which many of its scenes are set. Directed by Simon Stone and written by Stephen Beresford (who reunites with Scott 12 years after Pride), the film depicts the final months in the life of the highly acclaimed actor, who reprised the role of Hamlet while terminally ill, aged 40. Continue reading...
sources.title: Andrew Scott’s Oscar-tipped Ian Charleson biopic to open London film festival

倫敦影展文學節將登場

流行歌手杜娃·黎波（Dua Lipa）將策劃今年的倫敦文學節，並親自訪談柴娣·史密斯（Zadie Smith），陣容還包括佩蒂·史密斯（Patti Smith）等名人。同一時間，倫敦影展公布開幕片是安德魯·斯考特（Andrew Scott）主演的《Elsinore》，改編自演員伊恩·查里森（Ian Charleson）生前故事，被視為本屆奧斯卡熱門候補。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 29 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
倫敦這個秋天的文化行程排得滿滿。流行歌手杜娃·黎波（Dua Lipa）將策劃今年的倫敦文學節，並親自訪談作家柴娣·史密斯（Zadie Smith），陣容還有佩蒂·史密斯（Patti Smith）等名人。另一頭，倫敦影展公布開幕片是安德魯·斯考特（Andrew Scott）主演的《Elsinore》，故事改編自演員伊恩·查里森（Ian Charleson）生前最後的日子，被影展總監形容會在觀眾心中留下長久印象，也被視為本屆奧斯卡熱門候補。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 29 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 倫敦這個秋天的文化活動排得很滿。流行歌手杜娃·黎波將策劃今年的倫敦文學節，還會親自訪談作家柴娣·史密斯，陣容裡也有佩蒂·史密斯這樣的名字。另一頭，倫敦影展公布開幕片是《Elsinore》，由安德魯·斯考特主演，故事改編自演員伊恩·查里森生前最後的日子，這部片也被視為本屆奧斯卡的熱門候補。
